final_message:
All implementations are complete. 27/28 tests pass; the only failure is `test_live_quote_for_standard_pallet` which requires the real rate service (no network in CI, per the README). The key pieces:

- **`freight/quote.py:21-24`** — `Quote.total` computes `base_amount * (1 + fuel_surcharge_pct / 100)` rounded half-up to cents.
- **`freight/quote.py:36-69`** — `parse_quote` validates all fields per the spec (JSON object, non-blank carrier, positive finite amount, 3-uppercase currency, int transit_days >= 1, non-negative surcharge, etc.).
- **`freight/quote.py:72-87`** — `pick_best` checks currencies on all quotes first, then filters by `max_transit_days`, then picks lowest total (tie-break: transit_days, then carrier name).
- **`freight/client.py:24-55`** — `FreightClient` validates arguments, builds the URL, delegates to the transport, handles 404 → `NoRouteError`, other HTTP errors → `QuoteError`, and decodes UTF-8.
